name: Mimasaka Koharu
source:
Beautiful, yet completely useless older sister.

She relies on Akito in all aspects of her daily life and is deeply in love with him. Himeka's arrival brings end to it as she tries to become (only a little) more reliable older sister.

Her special skill in 100% accuracy in multiple answer questions.
